# Inside Mesh

Selects the part of your scene enclosed by a reference mesh.

`lfs.inside_mesh` · Selection

## How to use

Connect a closed mesh from Object Info to Mesh.\
Holes or self-intersections can make the inside ambiguous.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mesh | `Mesh` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Closed reference mesh defining the inside. Connect Object Info; an unconnected input cannot select anything. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.bool | — | — | On for selected elements, off for unselected elements. Connect to a Selection or Boolean input. |
